prompt:
Goal: Create a realistic browser-like screenshot of a dark Apple-style product landing page for iPhone 17 Pro, shown inside a charcoal comparison/viewer frame.

Canvas: Square 800×800 image with a very dark gray outer background. Add a thin neon-green rounded border around the whole viewer frame. In the top left of the frame place small green monospace text lina-f-alpha. In the top right place two small controls: a download icon and a rounded dark button labeled “Edit” with a pencil icon.

Main webpage card: Center a large rounded-rectangle browser/page panel, approximately 660 px wide and 660 px tall, with clipped corners. The page is black with a dark top navigation bar.

Navigation: Include exactly 9 navigation items across the top bar, small light-gray text: “Mac”, “iPad”, “iPhone”, “Watch”, “Vision”, “AirPods”, “TV y Casa”, “Entretenimiento”, “Soporte”.

Hero section: Use a premium Apple keynote aesthetic. At the top center of the black hero area show the product name “iPhone 17 Pro” in white. Below it place a huge bold Spanish headline Más Pro. Siempre. with a soft cream-to-orange gradient. Under the headline add the subheading Un salto enorme en potencia, cámaras y autonomía. in muted light gray. Below the subheading add exactly 2 pill buttons: a filled white button reading “Más información” and an outlined black button with white border reading “Comprar”.

Product image: The lower two-thirds of the page is dominated by an extreme close-up render of the back of a copper/orange iPhone, cropped so only the top back and camera island area are visible. Show exactly 3 large raised black camera lenses with copper metallic rings: one near the upper left, one lower left, and one near the upper middle. On the right side show exactly 3 smaller elements: a silver circular flash near the upper right, a tiny small dot below it, and a black circular sensor below-right. The phone body should have warm metallic reflections, subtle texture, rounded edges, and glossy shadows.

Bottom feature strip: Along the bottom of the webpage, overlay a dark translucent strip with exactly 4 feature cards separated by thin vertical divider lines. The leftmost card is partially cut off at the left edge, showing only the tail of text ending in “nites.” The second card has a white outline camera icon and text “Sistema de cámaras Pro” with subtext “Más detalle en cada historia.” The third card has a white battery icon and text “Autonomía para todo el día” with subtext “Llega más lejos.” The fourth card is partially visible on the right, with a white phone-outline icon and cropped Spanish text beginning “Pa…” and subtext beginning “Un…”.

Visual style: Photorealistic product render, high contrast, black luxury technology design, Spanish Apple-inspired typography, clean spacing, subtle glow on the copper finish, crisp UI elements, no watermark. Keep all text legible and do not add extra navigation items, extra buttons, or extra camera lenses.

promptZh:
目标：创建一张逼真的截图风格对比图，展示一个 AI 生成的 Apple 风格产品落地页，并置于深色 ChatGPT 图像结果框架内。

画布：4:3 正方形图像，约 800×800 像素，深炭灰色背景。在外部结果容器周围添加一圈细细的圆角霓虹绿轮廓。在顶部正中央，包含一个向下探出的白色对话气泡指针标签。

外部框架：带有圆角的深色 UI 容器。顶部栏高度约 52 像素。左侧显示 OpenAI 漩涡图标和绿色等宽字体标签 “gpt-image-2 (medium)”。右侧精确显示 2 个控件：一个小下载图标和一个带有铅笔图标的圆角 “Edit” 按钮。保持界面简洁且为深色。

内部网页：居中放置一张大型 Apple 风格主页截图，背景为黑色，相对于外部框架略微内缩。网页应进行裁剪，使左右两侧边缘略微切除。顶部是一个黑色导航栏，包含 8 个可见的菜单项，水平排列：“iPad”（左侧部分被截断）、“iPhone”、“Watch”、“Vision”、“AirPods”、“TV & Home”、“Entertainment” 以及 “Accessories”（右侧部分被截断）。

主图区域：为 “iPhone 17 Pro” 创建一个 Apple 风格的产品主图。将小号橙色产品名称置于顶部附近居中位置。下方制作一个巨大的粗体标题，内容为 “PRO. BEYOND.”，采用金属银到橙色的渐变色，具有光泽的立体字体，且两个单词后均带有句号。在标题下方，包含两行西班牙语副标题：“El iPhone más potente y avanzado hasta ahora.” 和 “Diseñado para lo que viene.”。在副标题下方精确放置 2 个行动号召链接：一个标有 “Más información” 的蓝色圆角按钮，以及一个标有 “Comprar >” 的蓝色文本链接。

产品图像：网页的下三分之二由一张橙色/铜色 iPhone 背面的微距渲染图占据，裁剪比例较大，仅显示上部背面和摄像头模组。在摄像头平台左侧精确显示 3 个呈三角形排列的黑色凸起摄像头镜头，右上角附近精确显示 1 个银色圆形闪光灯，下方精确显示 1 个微型点状传感器，右侧精确显示 1 个黑色椭圆形/圆形传感器。手机具有圆角、抛光铜色边缘、逼真的反射效果、底部中心附近隐约可见的浮雕 Apple 标志，以及摄影棚灯光效果。

视觉风格：超写实产品渲染与简洁网页模型的结合，具有光泽的 Apple 风格广告美学，高对比度黑色背景，橙色点缀，清晰的排版，无人物。

约束条件：保留西班牙语文本原样，保持所有数量精确，不要添加额外的按钮、图标、导航标签或产品功能，并避免在截图框架外出现水印或标题。
